patterns.note: The hero section employs a prominent two-column layout, featuring a large, left-aligned text block paired with a full-height image on the right side.
Content sections frequently utilize multi-column image grids, often with varying aspect ratios, to visually showcase the physical spaces and facilities.
Headings are set in a large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating a strong visual hierarchy that contrasts effectively with the lighter-weight body text.

A vibrant, electric blue is consistently used as a primary accent color for interactive elements like links and for the full-width footer background, providing a striking contrast to the otherwise neutral palette.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring persistent access to site sections.
Content sections appear to slide up into view as the user scrolls down the page, progressively revealing new information.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that maintains its position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll experience.
Content sections are designed to reveal themselves by simply scrolling into the viewport, creating a natural progression through the page content without complex, triggered animations.
The hero section combines a large text area with a full-height image, utilizing a flexible grid or flexbox layout to maintain its two-column structure responsively.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all elements, including images and structural blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design stands out through its strong emphasis on high-quality, abundant photography of the physical space, integrated seamlessly into a clean, editorial layout. The consistent use of sharp corners and a vibrant blue accent against a neutral palette gives it a distinctive, modern feel.
